name: exfu-marketplace
description: The ExFu marketplace: Alastair Brayne's Claude Code plugins in one place — the Agent Library (solo, team, team-admin), the ExFu planning methodology, the Agent Plan Visualiser, and Humane Agents, and the Multiaccount Google workspace MCP server (beta, devs only).

plugins.name: exfu-agent-library-solo
plugins.description: ExFu: your Agent Library. Claude as a real working collaborator, with Agent Librarians keeping your stuff organised so you can find it when you need it. Solo edition for individuals.

plugins.name: exfu-agent-library-team
plugins.description: ExFu: join your team's shared Agent Library and build your personal layer on top. Joiner edition.

plugins.name: exfu-agent-library-team-admin
plugins.description: ExFu: library-champion edition. Provision your team's shared Agent Library, author shared skills, brief IT, onboard members.

plugins.name: exfu-agent-planning-and-delegating
plugins.description: The ExFu approach: tiered planning methodology, grounded multi-model delegation to subscription-billed CLI agents (Codex via PAL clink), and schema-validated handoff contracts. Pairs optionally with agent-plan-visualiser for event capture.

plugins.name: exfu-humane-agents
plugins.description: Conventions for the human–agent interface: skills that make agent output serve human cognition — time-poor readers, jargon-blind readers, ADHD-friendly registers. First convention: dual-audience reporting (a rich agent report plus a short, plain human report).

plugins.name: exfu-agent-plan-visualiser
plugins.description: Event-sourced planning methodology with git-history extraction and projection. Walks a project's git history, extracts structured events against a defined ontology, and provides projections (audits, diagrams, status reports) over the resulting event log.

plugins.name: exfu-multiaccount
plugins.description: BETA, DEVS ONLY — ExFu multi-account Google workspace MCP server: Gmail (search, read, attachments, drafts), Drive, Docs and Calendar across several Google accounts at once, each routed by an explicit account alias. Local-only; you bring your own Google Cloud OAuth client and run it from Claude Code on your own machine. Tokens never leave your machine.
